purpose: Compare experiment selection policies, not photonic hardware performance

information_policy.history_visibility: identical initial snapshot and only own prior evaluated rounds
information_policy.candidate_feedback: same structured paired outcome schema for every strategy
information_policy.holdout_policy: no access to evaluation results before selection
information_policy.api_token_budget: record separately; not counted as training compute

selection_policy.duplicate_candidates: reject and record; no replacement without predeclared rule
selection_policy.tie_break: lower parameter count, then lower local width
selection_policy.failed_runs: count attempted candidate against budget; report separately

guardrails.backend: Q.ANT Native Computing Toolkit CPU; no photonic hardware claims

gpt-oss-120b.decoding_policy: temperature=0; one JSON object; record Groq request parameters, response, token use and model revision if supplied; no retry or replacement after invalid proposal
gpt-oss-120b.context_policy: same SHA-pinned initial snapshot and own prior completed paired outcomes only; no future holdout, cross-strategy feedback, external tools or retrieval

random-search.rng_algorithm: NumPy Generator PCG64; record numpy version
random-search.sampling_policy: uniform draw without replacement from ascending 4..15; fixed five-draw stream; consume one draw per round; history does not alter distribution

grid-search.traversal_order: ascending candidate widths 4..15; take next width each round without feedback-dependent reordering

bayesian-optimization.surrogate: GaussianProcessRegressor with Matern(nu=2.5), normalize_y=True, alpha=1e-6; width is one-dimensional numeric input; fit only own completed valid paired outcomes; record scikit-learn version
bayesian-optimization.acquisition: Expected Improvement xi=0.01 for scalar objective candidate_correct minus control_correct, with parameter saving as deterministic tie-break; maximize over unproposed discrete widths; no held-out future information
bayesian-optimization.initialization: first proposal width=10 (fixed independent of history); fit surrogate after first valid paired outcome; if no valid observations, choose smallest remaining width
bayesian-optimization.optimizer_policy: enumerate all remaining widths 4..15; deterministic lowest-width tie-break for equal acquisition; invalid/failed proposals consume a round; never refit on another strategy's observations
